name: worktree-guard
description: Configurable Git and native-edit awareness for base checkouts.

interface.longDescription: A lightweight accident-prevention hook that governs seven risky Git commands and harness-native file writes in Git base checkouts, in four independent groups (writes, branchChanges, discard, stash) until an agent explicitly requests access. Per-repo behavior is configured by a local .wtg.json: enabled, plus a disposition (allow/warn/block) and bypass (auto/manual/none) per group.
defaultPrompt: Use linked worktrees for file edits and risky Git operations.
